description: This file defines internal user management endpoints for an enterprise application built with FastAPI. It implements an API route '/user/available_users' that returns user and team usage data, including limits based on enterprise licensing.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: Type annotation for user API key authentication information.

classes.name: CommonProxyErrors
classes.description: Enum or class defining common proxy error types, such as database connection errors.

classes.name: EnterpriseLicenseData
classes.description: Data class holding enterprise license information such as 'max_users' and 'max_teams'.

methods.name: available_enterprise_users( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Asynchronous API endpoint handler that returns the number of total, used, and remaining users and teams based on enterprise license limits.
